pro_course_detail.title: Interview Strategy
pro_course_detail.description:
As featured on All Ears English http://allearsenglish.com/english-resume-strategies-straight-from-silicon-valley/ 

If you do not have a specific program or position you are applying to, please choose a hypothetical program/position or company/firm/college to do a mock interview to. It is important to learn how to deliver answers in a specific manner to a specific audience. This a content in context driven course designed to position you to say the right thing, at the right time, in the best way to win you the job or acceptance where ever you are applying to. Generic answers to generic questions will help with any interview. 

However, I want to groom you to answer in a manner which clearly sets you above others. 

**Please send your resume/CV, cover letter, job description of the position you desire or the program to which you are apply to, and the company/firm, college URL (where I can find information about where you are applying to) in MS Word format. Include a PDF version, if available -- especially if not written using a PC or Windows.** Please correspond via email NOT Skype. An email address to send documents will be given upon scheduling. 

WHILE THIS COURSE WILL HELP YOUR ENGLISH SKILLS, IT IS SPECIFICALLY DESIGNED TO HELP YOU ANSWER SPECIFIC INTERVIEW TYPE QUESTIONS. IT IS A MOCK INTERVIEW AND INTERVIEW STRATEGY COURSE. IF YOU ONLY WANT TO PRACTICE GENERAL ENGLISH, PLEASE ENROLL IN MY INFORMAL TUTORING SESSION.

pro_course_detail.title: Accent Reduction -- Motivational Speaking with Impact to Influence People
pro_course_detail.description:
Would you like to speak and make the same impact as Steve Jobs (Apple) and/or Mark Zuckerberg?

By using what is called, Vocal Variety--accenting pauses, adjectives, subject matter, and more, you will learn to speak as powerfully as the greats.

In this course we will go over your breathing, mouth movements, and shape of your mouth as you say single words, a continuous sentence, as well as a continuous paragraph. We will also work on transitions between sentences and paragraphs.

We can either use special software to train you to speak at a native rate of speech, continue to work on your pronunciation, or both.

pro_course_detail.title: Resume/CV, Cover Letter Wording & Layout, Personal Statement
pro_course_detail.description:

This course is designed to help you tell your own story that will get you hired. Many have no idea what to say, let alone how to say it on paper or in an interview. I will give you guidance of how to express yourself, but will not write the resume for you. Writing a resume or cover letter, with the correct wording and expression will be polished by me. However, your accomplishments originate from you. I can help you express your background. We will dig deep to uncover your talent that the employer wants to know. Knowing how to say the experience that only you know, but in a focused manner displays good writing skills that will land you the job. 

**No need to email me anything if you do not intend for me to use part of your session time offline.

pro_course_detail.title: How to Succeed in International Business Negotiation
pro_course_detail.description:
Negotiating is a fundamental part of doing business. Making sure you get the best terms for your product or service is essential to making sure your business not just survives, but thrives.
It’s hard enough to negotiate in your own language, but then to have to negotiate in a foreign language such as English?! 

In this lesson we look at your negotiation style and techniques and how you can adopt customs and idioms that are particular to your international environment.  

Objectives: 
- To use common vocabulary used during negotiations
- To introduce common business negotiation idioms (e.g. get down to business, meet half-way)
- To practice being polite (including modal verbs for politeness, the past tense to be polite and other common ways to be polite)
- To practice the use of conditional phrases in negotiations (e.g. as long as, on condition that)
- Vocabulary covered: a show of hands, a win-win situation, meet half-way, stick ot the point, get down to business, have (something) to add, close the deal, diplomatic, final offer, in favor of (something), concern, consideration, under one condition, proposal, consult, decline, interrupt, reconvene, recap, clarify, compromise, mutual, tactful, binding, non-negotiable, unanimous, face-to-face, provision, consensus, tactic, interest, contingency.

pro_course_detail.title: How to Conduct International Business Meetings
pro_course_detail.description:
Business meetings are conducted differently in different parts of the world. Whether you start business right away, engage in small talk, use humor - even something like organizing and how the meetings are followed up are different depending on your country of business. 

In this lesson we look at international business meeting vocabulary, but we also look at how your style of conducting business meetings might vary, depending on where you are and with whom you are meeting. 

Objectives: 
- To use common vocabulary used during different stages of a business meeting (introductions, reviewing past business/meeting notes, discussing items, finishing the meeting)
- To introduce common phrasal verbs used in business meetings (e.g. run out of, reach out)
- To introduce common expressions used in meetings
- To look at different styles of meetings, depending on your country
- Vocabulary covered: small talk, attending, absentees, standing in, tasks, the Chair/chairperson, minutes, prior commitment, run through, take over, go over, move on, agenda, item, input, on the same page, reach out to, break up, brainstorm, run out of (time), close, deal with, come back to (something), punctual, clarification, consensus, objectives, preside over.
